comparison.objective: Carry four filled glasses into a bus tub in one trip; candidate separates finishing media from washers and returns the screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object pinch carrying while keeping hollow tumblers upright and contents contained versus bilateral screen grasp, controlled tilt/agitation, selective passage, and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Four upright delivered glasses with ice/straws retained, one trip, release and stillness versus ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill, supported screen and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both penalize content loss, but carrying intact containers and screening intermixed free bodies test different abilities; the one-trip constraint is not candidate-relevant. Missing rubric details: none material.
